snippet.title: Do You Like Italian Food? | Visual Novel
snippet.description:
Download for Free: https://sbds.itch.io/dylif-vn
_____________________________________
Jared finally asks Liz out.
That is the whole problem.
_____________________________________

Do You Like Italian Food? is a short, slice-of-life, romantic visual novel about a shy college student, a coffee shop crush, and finding the nerve to ask for a date.

Jared is only supposed to be stopping by for caffeine. Instead, he keeps finding himself drawn back by a smile, a little conversation, and the hope that maybe this could become more than part of his routine.

So, he tries to ask her out like a normal person.
